dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>That Pokémon gets scared really easy and they HATE
dark places.

<$voicel(2,7)>It’s pretty deep and dark over there. I wonder if they got
lost. <$facial(2,9)><$voicel(2,4)>I’m kinda worried about them.

<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,839)><$comeff(2,21)>Oooh, you met <$cdef(27)><$cname(560)>? YAY! If they need anything,
make sure to help ’em out!
